title: Hanasato Minori — My First Vocal Range Check!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We actually get to sing it now!
I'll be waiting once I get my voice all warmed up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good idea. I think I'll join you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Seems a bit early to warm up, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A bit?! It's way too early!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Oh, before I forget.
Would you mind doing a little favor for me?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, what would you like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <As I work on this song and put the final touches on it, my goal will be to give it more of an MMJ feel...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like to know if there are any words, phrases or other things you'd like me to include in this song.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <By incorporating what you value most, my hope is that it'll turn into something that really hits home with not just you, but your fans as well.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something that really hits home with us and our fans...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's gonna be a song that brings us all together! That's so beautiful! Like movingly beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll tell you whatever you like!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Of course, we'll also be more than happy to tell you all about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I won't be using what you say word for word per se, but I'd like to learn more about what you feel is most important to you as they come to mind!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, clovers for one!
They're even a part of our outfits!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh no! I forgot...!
I'm not supposed to talk about our SEKAI outfits! I need to divert her away from that somehow...!)

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right. There were some on the outfits Hinomori designed. I remember thinking that they make for a really adorable motif.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Y-Y-Yeah, those!
They're super cute, right?! Hahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By the way, Hasegawa, do you happen to know what three-leaf clovers symbolize?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's more like what I want to value moving forward as opposed to what I value now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How there's more to being an idol than just standing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even if you get laughed at, even when you can't be on stage anymore... Idols can still spread and inspire hope in others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I kinda like the phrase, “I'm going to win against yesterday's me!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, it really is!
This is why Airi's such a cool person!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you the one getting giddy, Shizuku? Also, how about you go next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, me?
I like the phrase, “It's important for idols to have heart.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! Airi told you that when you were both still in training, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! I had to stay to keep working on my dancing and Airi decided to lend me a hand...

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Thank you all very much. My heart won't stop pounding after getting to hear such precious stories!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo! I'm glad you had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold up. That wasn't the point of this conversation.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That just leaves you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Haruka, what words or things do you see as being most important to you?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You may be asking the right question, but someone else really should be doing the asking...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. What's most important to me is to, of course, keep spreading hope to everyone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But these words left the biggest impression on me during my career as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! I wanna hear!
What kind of words?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “I want you to see this view! To remember what it's like to look forward! I want you to believe again that tomorrow will be a better day!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's what you told me, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. You're the one who “gave me hope for a better tomorrow”.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line:
<Thank you so much!
What I learned today has given me a much better understanding of all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. Feel free to ask anytime if you have any questions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since there are some things that we can't really talk about on our streams.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Uh oh... Looks like one of us still hasn't come back down to Earth yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She seems so happy.
Why don't we let her enjoy her moment of bliss a bit longer?
